# Instructions

- Always respond in a clear and concise manner.

# Task

- Create a new feature for global navigation
- The navigation should be accessible from all pages in the application.
- It should include links to the main sections of the app, such as "Home", "Deck Comparison", "Matchup Records", and "Saved Decks".
- The navigation should be responsive and work well on both desktop and mobile devices.
- We should use a combination of icons and text for the navigation links.
- The navigation should highlight the active link based on the current page.

# Outcome

- A new global navigation component is created.
- The navigation is accessible from all pages in the application.
- Links to the main sections of the app are included.
- The navigation is responsive and works well on both desktop and mobile devices.
- A combination of icons and text is used for the navigation links.
- The active link is highlighted based on the current page.
- The component is styled using tailwindcss and follows the existing design patterns in the application.
